name: psd-2026-09-24
title: USDA FAS Production, Supply and Distribution (PSD), 2026-09-24 snapshot
description: Views on the USDA FAS PSD all-commodities file as published on 2026-09-24. PSD overwrites earlier estimates every month, so the snapshot date is part of the data's identity. See in/SOURCES.md in the useful-views-data repository for full provenance.

licenses.name: other-pd
licenses.title: Not stated by FAS. As a work of the US federal government it is likely public domain (17 U.S.C. §105).

sources.title: USDA FAS PSD Online, All Commodities (CSV), 2026-09-24

resources.name: psd_alldata
resources.description: The PSD all-commodities file as published on 2026-09-24, every column unchanged but typed. One row per commodity, country, market year and attribute.

fields.name: Commodity_Code
fields.description: 7-digit PSD commodity code, zero-padded (e.g. 0440000 Corn).

fields.name: Commodity_Description
fields.description: Commodity name. One name per Commodity_Code.

fields.name: Country_Code
fields.description: 2-character PSD country code, FIPS 10-4 style, not ISO 3166 (e.g. CH China, GM Germany). Includes aggregates such as E4 European Union that overlap their member countries, and historical entities such as UR Union of Soviet Socialist Republics that overlap their successors; summing countries can double count.

fields.name: Country_Name
fields.description: Country or region name. One name per Country_Code.

fields.name: Market_Year
fields.description: Marketing year the value applies to. Local marketing years start in different months for different commodities and countries; not a calendar year.

fields.name: Calendar_Year
fields.description: Year the value was last revised, not the year it applies to.

fields.name: Month
fields.description: Month the value was last revised (1-12); 0 where PSD gives no month.

fields.name: Attribute_ID
fields.description: 3-digit PSD attribute code, zero-padded (e.g. 028 Production).

fields.name: Attribute_Description
fields.description: Attribute name as PSD publishes it. One name per Attribute_ID.

fields.name: Unit_ID
fields.description: 2-digit PSD unit code. One unit per (Commodity_Code, Attribute_ID).

fields.name: Unit_Description
fields.description: Unit name as PSD publishes it (e.g. (1000 MT), (MT/HA)). Never sum across units.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The value, in Unit_Description. The latest estimate as of the snapshot: PSD overwrites earlier estimates. 34% of values are zero; whether a zero means zero or not reported is not documented.

resources.name: commodity_attribute
resources.description: Every attribute PSD reports for each commodity, with its unit, as published. One row per commodity and attribute pair found in psd_alldata.

fields.name: Commodity_Code
fields.description: 7-digit PSD commodity code, zero-padded (e.g. 0440000 Corn).

fields.name: Commodity_Description
fields.description: Commodity name as PSD publishes it.

fields.name: Attribute_ID
fields.description: 3-digit PSD attribute code, zero-padded (e.g. 028 Production).

fields.name: Attribute_Description
fields.description: Attribute name as PSD publishes it.

fields.name: Unit_Description
fields.description: Unit of this attribute for this commodity, as PSD publishes it. The same attribute can have different units for different commodities (e.g. Production is 1000 MT for corn but 1000 480 lb. Bales for cotton).

resources.name: world_balance
resources.description: Every country in psd_alldata summed to a world total. One row per commodity, market year and attribute. Rates and ratios are left out (Extr. Rate, Milling Rate, Seed to Lint Ratio, Yield, Stocks-to-Use, Annual % Change Per Cap. Cons.).

fields.name: Commodity_Code
fields.description: 7-digit PSD commodity code, zero-padded (e.g. 0440000 Corn).

fields.name: Commodity_Description
fields.description: Commodity name as PSD publishes it.

fields.name: Market_Year
fields.description: Marketing year. Each country's local marketing year is summed as is, so world imports and exports don't match: compare TY Imports and TY Exports for trade.

fields.name: Attribute_ID
fields.description: 3-digit PSD attribute code, zero-padded (e.g. 028 Production).

fields.name: Attribute_Description
fields.description: Attribute name as PSD publishes it.

fields.name: Unit_Description
fields.description: Unit as PSD publishes it. Never sum across units.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: Sum of Value over every country in psd_alldata, with no country dropped or adjusted. A few known cases count the same quantity twice; see the README's known overlaps.

fields.name: n_countries
fields.description: Number of countries with a nonzero Value.
